measures.what: overall diameter of the circular board
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two mounting holes near the centre: diameter of each hole
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: centre-to-centre distance between the two mounting holes near the centre
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges)
led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: overall length (long side) and width, and thickness
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the four corner holes: diameter, and centre-to-centre spacing along length and width
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

measures.what: the ESP32 DevKitC body: length, width, and height of the board above the perfboard top, plus the USB-C port's distance from the nearest perfboard edge and from the ESP32 board's end
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: plug body width, height, and how far the plug's metal shell extends from the charger's face
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: head diameter and head height, and whether you intend to use these for the perfboard or the wall
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.item: wall screws you plan to hang the box on
measures.what: screw shank diameter and head diameter, and their centre spacing horizontally on the wall
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.what: where the 4-pin input connector sits on the disk: distance from the disc centre to the connector's centre, measured along the wire exit direction
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12
